reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, dayFromDate/parseDate and the captureBreadcrumb error pattern of getUpcomingDates; the daily-weekend-skip condition is re-expressed inline since no helper exists for it.

duplication.why: The daily-schedule weekend-skip rule (skipWeekend && frequency === 'daily' && isWeekend) is now stated a second time alongside getNextDate's own inline version, and the RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb scaffolding mirrors getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: A new handler in server/schedules/app.ts next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates, registered in SchedulesHandlers and app.method like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Short and readable with a commented window pad; the hard-coded 3-day pad and the separately stated daily-skip rule would need to be kept in sync with the shared weekend logic.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend shifting goes through getDateWithSkippedWeekend; no existing abstraction for the daily skip is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip condition is restated openly in getDatesInRange rather than disguised.
